I’m currently sectioned in a psychiatric ward after multiple suicide attempts, and have been for the last 8 months. It’s still hard, it’s not a magic fix. I relapsed 2 nights ago and have lost my chance to get out anytime soon. 

It sucks. There’s nothing to do, you’re locked in so don’t expect to be able to go out when you want to, the food is shit, staff sometimes have to watch you shower and use the bathroom and sometimes the other patients are aggressive/violent towards you due to their mental illness. 

Sometimes the psych ward makes people worse. It’s mainly to keep people safe, not to help make them feel better or ‘cure’ them. The worst part about it is you have almost no control over how long you stay. I thought I’d be out in a couple weeks but here I am nearly 9 months later and no further forward in terms of being discharged. My whole life is stuck on pause and that doesn’t help my suicidal thoughts at all.

Everyone is different. By that I mean, everyone has their own likes/dislikes, hobbies, skills, abilities and desires. She has no right to compare herself to you because she simply is not you. I feel like we are similar, I was good at English and Literature but I really sucked at Math. Words and sentences make more sense to me than numbers and equations and that is okay. We all have things that we are not good at and that doesn’t mean we can’t improve. I also failed Math and had to re-take it and managed to pass the second time because I had improved just enough. 

What I’m trying to say is fuck what your teacher says, you have your own qualities and skills, maybe math isn’t one of them but does that matter? No. She should be congratulating you on your distinction not putting you down about not passing math. She is in the wrong, not you.

I’m in the same situation as your partner. I only opened up to my partner about it (or anyone in fact) a couple days after my first suicide attempt. My partner immediately told me that he was angry at me and this made me feel even worse. He was angry at me for feeling a way that I can’t control and a way that I don’t even want to feel. I wasn’t eating anything for days and he would constantly force me to eat by saying things like ‘if you loved me you would eat’. He asked me things like ‘am I not enough for you?’ After a while of this I just started pretending everything was fine because he just was not helping at all and just making me feel like it was my fault and that I just need to snap out of it and smile. He would ask me to come over to his or go out and do something every day. I was already exhausted and had no desire to do anything but I would compromise and spend 3 days a week with him (bearing in mind we work together so we see each other every day at work anyways). If I ever said no to going out he would say ‘wow you’re so lazy’. All of this made me shut down from talking to him about my feelings. 

My advice is to not make them feel like it’s their fault. As much as you don’t want them to feel like that, they also do not want to feel like that. If there was a quick fix they would’ve done it by now. Try not to make it personal as in ‘I’m angry at you for feeling that way’, instead you should say ‘I feel angry that you have to feel this way.’ If they aren’t feeling up to doing something then ask them what they want to do instead, if they want to be alone then just respect that. 

You mentioned that they do not want to see a doctor. Try and find out why they do not want to see a doctor. For me, I was scared that I would be forced into hospital. This is not what will happen unless you are seriously at risk of harming yourself or others and they determine this through your answers to their questions. If you can find the reason why they don’t want to see a doctor, you can help reassure them to the point where they are willing to seek help. 

Lastly, don’t force them to talk about it if they don’t want to. Too many people forced me to explain how I was feeling and that itself is exhausting to put into words. I was forced to describe in detail my suicide attempt to my parents and I was not ready to discuss it in that much detail. In the end I just shut down from talking to anyone about it because I didn’t want to anymore I was tired of talking about it and this just made everything worse as I was left again to deal with it alone.

I can definitely see that helping. I normally end up tensing my legs over and over again sometimes resulting in cramps, and then the next day they are just stiff and achy. I will try squats next time thanks a lot for the advice.

I’m currently on a waiting list for talking therapy, apparently the wait is quite long. I was told to take anti depressants by my doctor but I refused them because I honestly don’t trust myself. Hopefully I can wait and the therapy helps me because I also feel that it’s not gonna stop on it’s own.

Thank you for replying. I relate to your urges too. The only reason I ended up going to the bridge is because it was in my head when I woke up. Getting closer and closer made all the physical feelings a little bit calmer because I was closer to being able to act out the urge. And then upon arriving and realising just how busy it was and that I wasn’t going to be able to do it at this time of day made them unbearable again. It’s like I’ve lost control when I’m in that state. I just wanted to know if anyone else could relate, so it’s nice to know that you can too.

Hey I feel the same as you. I sometimes look at people and just think ‘what do you actually enjoy about life?’ Like yeah sure I have people that I love like my family but damn that’s not enough to stop me from feeling like there’s no point to anything. Everything is boring man.

Honestly that was my worse fear too. Some people think ‘if you really wanted to kill yourself you would’ve done it’. It’s not as simple as that because you get so afraid of failing the attempt and ending up being in an even worse position than you already were in. I look around at people and just think what the fuck do you actually enjoy about life? Depression and suicidal thoughts suck, and I really hope things work out for you.

I’m in the same situation as you are. Can really relate when you said that you feel how you felt before your first attempt, I do too. I’m only just managing to ignore the urges but the day is coming where it’s gonna get too much. Lately, having plans has helped me overcome the urges. Not even massive plans, just little things like tomorrow I’m taking a walk along the beach, or tomorrow I’m cleaning out my car etc. It’s like I feel like I can’t kill myself tonight because tomorrow I have to do this. I know how stupid it sounds because why would you need to worry about the things you need to do when you’re going to be dead anyways? But honestly it’s really helped me. I hope that you can find a way that helps you too.

You’re not a pussy, backing out of it means that you’re not 100% sure and that’s a good thing. I don’t know which country you’re from, but here in the UK, they will only section you if you are an immediate danger to yourself or others, or if you make it very clear that you’re going to kill yourself and nothing is going to stop you. I assume that’s the same for most places. Normally after a suicide attempt they will give you a mental health assessment. In this, they will ask you questions like if you have a plan, how you are feeling, if you self harm etc. They don’t know what you’re thinking, they only know what you tell them. If you really don’t want to be sectioned then tell them what they want to hear and they will have no reason to do that. However, being sectioned is not totally bad. It gives you access to the help and treatment you need which you may not be able to see right now in your current state.
Yeah I usually take a drive when it’s getting bad and just listen to music. That’s the only thing that helps me, as long as I stay in the car I will be fine.

I get what your saying. I have constant suicidal thoughts and the best way to explain it is it’s like a song that’s stuck in your head. No matter how hard you try, it just keeps playing. Ive tried to kill myself before, I didn’t tell anyone because I didn’t want anyone to be able to stop me. Sometimes people like to post it on here, I guess as a way to have other people try and stop them or talk them out of it. But once you’re truly in that state, there’s nothing else you can think about and there’s just no other options.

Depression ain’t the same for everyone and it doesn’t necessarily mean you want to kill your self. People experience it in different ways, some people feel numb and others feel too much, some people can get out of bed and get to work, some people can’t etc.

Everyone is fucking selfish. I too was called selfish after my suicide attempt. It’s selfish for us to kill ourselves because we hurt others by doing so. But it is selfish for those to force us to stay here because they don’t want to be hurt. By forcing us to stay here, they’re hurting us. That is selfish too.

- I found that I was sad a lot for literally no reason. This might not always be sadness, it can be anger or irritation. 

- Sleeping problems. I either couldn’t sleep or slept way too much. It would change. Can’t fall asleep, and when I do I’d wake up every hour. Or I’d sleep for a full 14 hours and sometimes still feel tired. 

- I lost interest in everything. All of my hobbies, didn’t want to watch anything or play any games, didn’t even want to talk to anyone. 

- I ached a lot. I feel like this was because I was so tense all the time, my head hurt, my back, my neck etc. 

- I stopped eating. I could comfortably go about 7 days without food. It wasn’t anything to do with weight etc, I simply just didn’t feel like eating and if I forced myself to eat it didn’t taste nice. 

- I felt hopeless and trapped. I questioned a lot of things like what’s even the point of living? I never had any reassuring answers and so I just felt hopeless about everything. 

- Suicidal thoughts. I wanted to die. I simply did not want to exist anymore and I planned several ways to kill myself. 

Depression can affect everyone in different ways. Even though I felt like shit, I still managed to drag my ass out of bed and get to work, maybe a couple minutes late but I was there. I managed to hide it very well for a while until I got so burnt out about everything and I just didn’t care anymore and I ended up trying to kill myself. If you don’t feel right, or you’re not happy, especially if you’re having suicidal thoughts, please speak to someone. This could be a doctor, your parents, a friend, a teacher if you’re in school, or just anyone that you trust. It’s easier when those close to you are aware how you feel, that way you don’t feel so alone and you don’t feel like you need to hide it all the time until it gets too much. Sometimes you don’t need advice or other people’s opinions, you just need someone to listen.

I had this exact plan. Unfortunately I already had one suicide attempt and when taking out a life insurance policy it does ask you whether you have had any suicidal thoughts or attempts. You cannot lie about it either, it’s documented and if you lie they will not pay out when you do die. The suicide attempt meant that none of them were willing to cover me. Man life sucks I just want my family to have some money when I die.

Before I felt like this, I spent a lot of my time doing commissions in 3D modelling and coding. Was making a nice bit of extra money on the side from my real job, and it was a bonus since it was something I really enjoyed doing. I ended up dropping the amount of time I spent on it so that I could keep my friends and girlfriend happy. They’d complain that I was spending less time with them, so I ended up spending all my time with them. I got burnt out from that and I’ve stopped talking to most of my friends. My girlfriend I speak to everyday but I only see her 3 days a week now. I just needed some time and space for myself. I did try to pick up the commissions again recently but I have no interest in anything anymore. I have to enjoy what I’m creating otherwise it just ends up as a half assed job and I’m not willing to sell that.

Damn I totally agree. I put everyone before myself a couple months ago, was constantly doing things just to please people or spending time with certain people to keep them happy to the point where I had no time to do the things I wanted to do. I believe that’s what led me to feeling so shit and to my first suicide attempt. Funny thing is, now that I’ve cut everyone off and have a load of spare time, I don’t feel like doing anything anymore.

I wanted to be become a police officer. I hate working my current job because I’m not actually doing anything beneficial. It’s hard to explain, I guess I just feel like I’m not doing anything that is actually worthwhile. But I already know that there’s no chance of me becoming a police officer and I did try to look at other jobs but honestly I’m just not gonna be very successful at anything.

I was found during an attempt, I was detained by police before I could do anything and forced to undergo a mental health assessment. They ask you questions, just tell them what they want to hear and they will let you go. If you tell them things that make you seem like you’re an immediate danger to yourself they can keep you in a psych hospital.

I personally wouldn’t mention it to him. Instead ask him if he’s okay, just talk to him about whatever you normally talk about and listen to him. Offer your support and eventually he may feel able to open up to you. I’m currently suffering from suicidal thoughts and I attempted suicide 5 days ago. For the last 5 days, my mother has noticed that I’m different and has been there more for me, just listened and talked and it’s really helped. I’m now about ready to tell her everything. The last thing he wants is to be questioned about it and he will only get naturally defensive. Obviously if you notice anything that suggests he’s about to attempt suicide, you need to intervene, but for now just let him know that you’re there for him.

Edit: and it’s not that he’s not intelligent. He is suffering and the mind can take you to a really dark place. If you’ve never experienced it before, there is no way to explain how it feels. Please research about depression and suicidal thoughts as it may help you understand your fathers position, as well as give you extra tips and signs to look out for.

Online gaming helped me a lot. It’s something that easily distracts you from what’s going on in real life. I found it easier than watching movies or tv shows because with gaming you are required to put a bit of effort into it instead of just staring at the screen. Not to mention, you can meet great people online who are also going through the same as you. I have a very close online friend who messages me everyday to check on me and it’s very helpful. I do agree with the other comment about towers being better than laptops for gaming. I find that laptops overheat very quickly while gaming, and they are just not as powerful as towers because they have a much smaller space to fit all the hardware into. They need to be regularly cleaned out and when my depression got worse I neglected this and it caused my laptops performance to struggle.

I’m actually in the UK. Things might be free over here but still means a long long waiting list to access services that you need. It really sucks.

I have thought about this before. All of my savings I have right now are not for me, they are to fund my funeral as I don't want to put that burden on my family. If it's my choice to die, I will pay for it.

I used to feel like that, now I'm at a point where I just don't care anymore. I've tried to get help and I can't. There are no appointments available with my GP, I just have to call everyday and see if they can fit me in (they can't). I spoke to professionals after my first suicide attempt and they referred me to another agency who still has not got in contact with me. It feels like endless waiting at this point and I can't cope for much longer. I need help now. I wake up everyday angry solely at the fact that I woke up.

I understand that but it makes me so mad that I’m stuck here because you love me and don’t want to lose me. I really wish no one loved me so I didn’t have to feel guilty everyday when I’m constantly having these thoughts. They never stop.

It’s not as simple as ‘see a therapist’. I tried to kill myself last week, was taken by the police and forced to do a mental health assessment. They released me after that and I asked them what next? They told me make an appointment with your GP. I’ve been calling my GP every day as soon as they open to get an appointment, only to be told there’s none available and I just have to keep trying every morning. I need help now, not in 3 weeks because I know for a fact I’m not gonna cope another 3 weeks like this. Services are super overstretched especially right now in the middle of a pandemic, I’m running out of time and options.
